name: Champion's Seal
description: Awarded for valiant acts in the Crusader's Coliseum.

name: Tol Barad Commendation
description: Awarded for brave deeds performed on Tol Barad.

name: Darkmoon Prize Ticket
description: Awarded for winning games or doing favors at the Darkmoon Faire.

name: Timewarped Badge
description: Earned in Timewalking dungeons. Exchanged for goods from Timewalking Vendors in capital cities.

name: Order Resources
description: Used to recruit troops, run missions, and research upgrades for your order hall.

name: Nethershard
description: A fragment of crystallized nether brought to Azeroth by the Legion.

name: War Resources
description: Used to recruit troops, run missions, and research upgrades for your war effort.

name: Seafarer's Dubloon
description: Currency used by the many varied tribes of the Great Sea. Used to procure items from traders on Island Expeditions.

name: Honorbound Service Medal
description: A badge of merit for action taken on the battlefields of Kul Tiras, Zandalar, and active Warfronts. Sought by Provisioner Mukra at the port of Zandalar. For the Horde!

name: 7th Legion Service Medal
description: A badge of merit for action taken on the battlefields of Kul Tiras, Zandalar, and active Warfronts. Sought by Provisioner Stoutforge in Boralus. For the Alliance!

name: Corrupted Mementos
description: Fragments of memory from Horrific Visions of N'Zoth which can be analyzed at the Titanic Research Archive in the Chamber of Heart.

name: Prismatic Manapearl
description: A glistening sphere of arcane energy found around Nazjatar. These can be traded for rare and powerful items, or used to empower Benthic armor.

name: Echoes of Ny'alotha
description: Scoured of N'Zoth's corruption, MOTHER can use this substance to synthesize essences in the Chamber of Heart.

name: Community Coupons
description: Earned from completing Endeavor tasks to support your Neighborhood and its friends. Used to purchase items from Endeavor Traders and some other vendors in your Neighborhood.
